cases.name: mhchem_reaction_arrow_requires_unregistered_mhchem_font_extension
cases.coverage_note: The reference profile emits an SVG but records warning `Invalid variant: -mhchem`. MhchemUtils.relmo assigns -mhchem to relation glyphs; the TeX extension component requests the separate `mathjax-mhchem-font-extension` font package, while entry.cjs only attaches bboldx, bbm, and dsfont extensions. NewCM defaultVariants also has no -mhchem variant. That separate mhchem font extension is required for clean arrow/relation coverage, and is not installed or registered in this production profile, so this case is a profile limitation rather than valid parity coverage.
